events.title: US strikes Iran's Larak Island; Iran retaliates against US bases in Jordan
events.why_it_matters: First US military action in a month against Iran re-escalates the 2026 Iran war, pushing Brent above $90 and threatening Strait of Hormuz shipping.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Iran escalates further against Gulf shipping or US bases; oil price reaction above $90 Brent.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh hawkish Jackson Hole speech raises September rate hike odds
events.why_it_matters: Warsh signaled inflation 'still too high' and rate hikes may be needed, pushing fed funds futures to ~56% odds of a September hike.
events.what_to_watch: August CPI (Sep 11) and jobs report (Sep 4) for confirmation; FOMC meeting Sep 15-16.

events.title: FOMC meeting September 15-16 — rate hike now a coin flip
events.why_it_matters: Markets now price ~56% odds of a 25bp hike after Warsh's hawkish pivot; a hike would be the first since 2023 and could trigger broad risk-off.
events.what_to_watch: Fed funds futures, 2-year Treasury yield, and whether Warsh gets enough votes for a hike.

events.title: US August jobs report (Sep 4) — consensus ~25K, after July's -23K surprise
events.why_it_matters: July payrolls unexpectedly fell 23K; August consensus is only ~25K, making this a critical data point for the September Fed decision.
events.what_to_watch: Whether payrolls rebound or contract again; unemployment rate at 4.1%.

events.title: US August CPI release (Sep 11) — consensus ~3.3-3.4% YoY
events.why_it_matters: July CPI was 3.4% YoY; this print lands just days before the FOMC and will be decisive for whether Warsh can push through a hike.
events.what_to_watch: Core CPI trajectory; any upside surprise would cement a September hike.

events.title: OPEC+ meeting Sep 6 — likely to pause output hikes for October
events.why_it_matters: After six consecutive monthly increases, OPEC+ sources suggest a pause for Q4; combined with Iran tensions, this supports higher oil prices.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the group pauses or continues increases; Saudi-Russia alignment on production.

events.title: ECB rate decision Sep 10 — hike expected to 2.50%
events.why_it_matters: ECB policymakers ready to raise rates to contain side-effects of fiscal expansion; current rate 2.25%.
events.what_to_watch: Whether ECB signals further hikes or a pause after September.

events.title: BOJ September rate hike — market-implied probability ~57%
events.why_it_matters: BOJ sources signal a September hike and faster tightening pace; yen strength could pressure Japanese exporters and global carry trades.
events.what_to_watch: BOJ meeting date confirmation; yen/USD reaction and Nikkei response.

events.title: China PMI August: manufacturing 49.8 (contraction), services 49.0
events.why_it_matters: Second straight month of manufacturing contraction and services stuck at 49.0 signals continued economic weakness despite stimulus efforts.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the $119B policy financing tool and other stimulus measures gain traction in Q4.

events.title: China's $119B policy financing tool opens for local government projects
events.why_it_matters: 800B yuan policy-based financing tool aims to shore up local government infrastructure projects and counter economic slowdown.
events.what_to_watch: Speed of project approvals and disbursement; whether it translates into actual economic activity.

events.title: US declares national emergency over bulk-power system security (EO 14421)
events.why_it_matters: Executive order prohibits foreign-produced bulk-power system equipment, creating new supply chain compliance requirements for utilities and grid equipment makers.
events.what_to_watch: Which foreign suppliers are affected; impact on grid equipment costs and utility capex.

events.title: US-Canada trade war escalates: 50% tariffs, Canada retaliates Sep 8
events.why_it_matters: US imposed 50% tariffs on $27.6B of Canadian goods; Canada retaliates with 15-50% tariffs on ~700 US products effective Sep 8.
events.what_to_watch: Whether negotiations resume before Sep 8; impact on auto, lumber, agriculture, and consumer goods prices.

events.title: SEC proposes 'Regulation Crypto Assets' framework
events.why_it_matters: First purpose-built crypto offering regime with startup exemption and safe harbor; could unlock institutional crypto adoption.
events.what_to_watch: Comment period through Oct 20; final rule timeline and industry response.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings: $96.2B revenue, +106% YoY, stock falls
events.why_it_matters: Nvidia beat on revenue but shares fell as investors focused on guidance and AI capex sustainability; bellwether for entire AI trade.
events.what_to_watch: Q3 guidance of ~$108B; whether AI infrastructure spending cycle continues.

events.title: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 earnings Sep 2 — AI revenue expected ~$29B
events.why_it_matters: Broadcom is the next major AI chip bellwether after Nvidia; consensus near $29B revenue with earnings expected to rise 90%+.
events.what_to_watch: AI networking revenue growth; guidance for fiscal 2027; whether stock breaks $379.

events.title: US GDP Q2 2026 second estimate: 1.5% annualized, unchanged
events.why_it_matters: Sluggish 1.5% growth confirms economic deceleration from 2.1% in Q1, supporting stagflation concerns with inflation at 3.4%.
events.what_to_watch: Q3 GDP tracking; whether growth slows further under tariff and rate pressure.

events.title: US PCE inflation July: 3.7% YoY, above 3.6% forecast
events.why_it_matters: PCE at 3.7% YoY, above expectations, reinforces Warsh's hawkish stance and supports case for September rate hike.
events.what_to_watch: Whether August PCE (Sep 30) shows further acceleration.

events.title: US retail sales July: first decline in 9 months
events.why_it_matters: Consumer spending slowed to weakest pace in 7 months, adding to evidence of economic softening.
events.what_to_watch: August retail sales (Sep 16) for confirmation of consumer slowdown.

events.title: US-Iran ceasefire expired Aug 17 without deal; war re-escalating
events.why_it_matters: 60-day ceasefire from June MOU expired without final deal; US reimposed naval blockade and now struck Iranian targets, keeping oil above $90.
events.what_to_watch: Whether diplomacy resumes or conflict escalates further; Strait of Hormuz shipping disruptions.

events.title: Boeing SPEEA union rejects contract, authorizes strike (potential Oct 7)
events.why_it_matters: 17,000 Boeing engineers/technical workers rejected contract and authorized strike; negotiations resume but strike possible from Oct 7.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Boeing and SPEEA reach a deal before contract expires Oct 6; production disruption risk.

events.title: Super El Niño (>90% probability of very strong event) developing
events.why_it_matters: Very strong El Niño (>90% probability) could disrupt global crop yields, energy demand, and commodity supply chains through late 2026.
events.what_to_watch: Crop price movements (coffee, cocoa, sugar); winter weather patterns in North America.

events.title: US midterm elections Nov 3 — markets pricing potential Congress flip
events.why_it_matters: Markets increasingly pricing possibility of Democrats taking House/Senate, which could constrain Trump's tariff and fiscal agenda.
events.what_to_watch: Polling trends through September; primary results; policy implications for tariffs, taxes, and spending.

events.title: US debt hits $40 trillion, months earlier than expected
events.why_it_matters: Faster-than-expected borrowing means next debt ceiling deadline arrives ahead of schedule, likely in 2027, raising fiscal risk concerns.
events.what_to_watch: Treasury issuance trajectory; long-end yield pressure; fiscal sustainability debate.

events.title: Senate deal to avert shutdown through midterms reached Aug 3
events.why_it_matters: Bipartisan agreement keeps government funded past November midterms, removing near-term shutdown risk.
events.what_to_watch: Whether House passes the funding deal; any last-minute complications.

events.title: South Korea exports surge 56% in August on semiconductor boom
events.why_it_matters: Record August exports ($55.2B, +56% YoY) with semiconductors up 198.8%, confirming global AI chip demand supercycle.
events.what_to_watch: Whether chip export momentum continues into Q4; implications for Samsung, SK Hynix, and global tech supply chain.

events.title: Taiwan semiconductor exports hit third-best month ($75.3B) in July
events.why_it_matters: TSMC-led chip exports continue record run; 78.5% of outbound sales in semiconductor categories, driving Taiwan's explosive GDP growth.
events.what_to_watch: TSMC capex of $52-56B in 2026; AI chip demand sustainability.

events.title: US-China tariff exclusions extended on 178 Chinese products to Nov 10
events.why_it_matters: USTR extended tariff exclusions on 178 Chinese products through Nov 10, providing temporary relief for importers.
events.what_to_watch: Whether exclusions are renewed again or allowed to expire after midterms.

events.title: AI TechWorld conference Sep 1-3, Santa Clara — AI infrastructure focus
events.why_it_matters: Premier AI engineering conference could provide catalysts for AI infrastructure and semiconductor stocks.
events.what_to_watch: Announcements on AI compute, data center, and networking innovations.

events.title: US mortgage rates at 6.66% (30-yr fixed) — housing affordability pressure
events.why_it_matters: Mortgage rates remain elevated near 6.7%, constraining housing affordability and home sales; FHFA house prices up only 2.1% YoY.
events.what_to_watch: Whether rate hike expectations push mortgage rates higher; housing market data.

events.title: US initial jobless claims at 203K (week ending Aug 22) — labor market cooling
events.why_it_matters: Jobless claims remain low but employment-to-population ratio at lowest since 2014, signaling labor market weakness beneath the surface.
events.what_to_watch: Weekly claims trend; August jobs report for confirmation of labor market trajectory.

events.title: US-China trade truce holding but points of friction remain
events.why_it_matters: Tariff rates reduced to 30% after November 2025 deal, but semiconductor export controls and H200 chip tariffs remain contentious.
events.what_to_watch: Any new export control actions; China's response to US semiconductor policy.

events.title: Fed July FOMC minutes (Aug 19) — 9-3 vote, dissents push for hike
events.why_it_matters: Three dissents at July meeting raised pressure for September hike; minutes showed September hike 'still on the table'.
events.what_to_watch: Whether more officials join the hawkish camp by September meeting.

events.title: US CPI July: 3.4% YoY, core 2.5% — cooling but above target
events.why_it_matters: Headline cooled to 3.4% from 3.5%, core at 2.5%; but Warsh argues inflation still too high and PCE at 3.7% shows persistence.
events.what_to_watch: August CPI on Sep 11 for trend confirmation.

events.title: 2026 hurricane season quiet so far — El Niño suppressing activity
events.why_it_matters: Only 3 named storms so far; El Niño suppressing peak-season activity, reducing energy and insurance disruption risk.
events.what_to_watch: September peak hurricane season; any late-season development.

events.title: US Space Academy executive order (Aug 28) — space sector policy
events.why_it_matters: New executive order establishes US Space Academy, signaling continued space policy focus and potential defense/space industry tailwinds.
events.what_to_watch: Implementation details and budget allocations.

events.title: Apple v. Epic Games — Supreme Court granted certiorari (Jun 30)
events.why_it_matters: SCOTUS will hear Apple v. Epic in upcoming term; ruling could reshape app store economics and platform antitrust standards.
events.what_to_watch: Oral argument date;
